```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(xgboost)
library(Matrix)
```

## Data Inputs

```{r paths}
repo_root <- normalizePath("..")

seasons <- list(
  list(season = "2024", box = file.path(repo_root, "2024", "master_boxscore.csv"),
       gl = file.path(repo_root, "2024", "master_gamelog.csv")),
  list(season = "2025", box = file.path(repo_root, "2025", "master_boxscore.csv"),
       gl = file.path(repo_root, "2025", "master_gamelog.csv"))
)
```

## Build Features From Boxscores

```{r boxscore_features}
stat_cols <- c(
  "FG", "FGA", "FG%", "3P", "3PA", "3P%", "2P", "2PA", "2P%",
  "eFG%", "FT", "FTA", "FT%", "ORB", "DRB", "TRB", "AST", "STL",
  "BLK", "TOV", "PF", "PTS"
)

load_box_totals <- function(path, season) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(player == "School Totals", str_to_lower(table_type) == "basic") %>%
    transmute(
      season = season,
      game_id,
      game_date = as.Date(game_date),
      sid = team,
      opp_sid = if_else(is.na(opponent) | opponent == "", "no_sid", opponent),
      across(all_of(stat_cols), as.numeric, .names = "tm_{.col}")
    )
}

box_totals <- seasons %>%
  lapply(function(s) load_box_totals(s$box, s$season)) %>%
  bind_rows()

opp_stats <- box_totals %>%
  select(game_id, sid, starts_with("tm_")) %>%
  rename(opp_sid = sid) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "^tm_", "opp_"), starts_with("tm_"))

box_features <- box_totals %>%
  left_join(opp_stats, by = c("game_id", "opp_sid"))
```

## Build Features From Gamelogs

```{r gamelog_features}
load_gamelogs <- function(path, season) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      season = season,
      date = as.Date(date),
      sid = str_trim(sid),
      opp_sid = if_else(is.na(opp_sid) | opp_sid == "", "no_sid", opp_sid)
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      season,
      sid,
      date,
      opp_sid,
      loc = if_else(is.na(loc) | loc == "", "H", loc),
      type = if_else(is.na(type), "", type),
      g_seq,
      ot,
      res,
      tm_score,
      opp_score
    )
}

gamelogs <- seasons %>%
  lapply(function(s) load_gamelogs(s$gl, s$season)) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

## Assemble Modeling Table

```{r assemble}
data_full <- box_features %>%
  left_join(
    gamelogs,
    by = c("season", "sid" = "sid", "game_date" = "date", "opp_sid" = "opp_sid")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    win = case_when(
      res == "W" ~ 1,
      res == "L" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(win))

# Basic feature cleanup
data_full <- data_full %>%
  mutate(
    loc = factor(loc, levels = c("H", "@", "N")),
    type = as.factor(type)
  )
```

## Train / Test Split

```{r split}
train_df <- data_full %>% filter(season == "2024")
test_df <- data_full %>% filter(season == "2025")

feature_cols <- setdiff(
  names(data_full),
  c("season", "game_id", "game_date", "sid", "opp_sid", "res", "win")
)

# Drop single-level factors in the training set to avoid contrasts errors.
train_features <- train_df[, feature_cols, drop = FALSE]
factor_cols <- names(train_features)[vapply(train_features, is.factor, logical(1))]
single_level <- factor_cols[
  vapply(train_features[factor_cols], function(x) length(unique(x)) < 2, logical(1))
]
if (length(single_level) > 0) {
  train_features <- train_features[, setdiff(names(train_features), single_level), drop = FALSE]
}

x_train <- sparse.model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = train_features)
y_train <- train_df$win

test_features <- test_df[, names(train_features), drop = FALSE]
x_test <- sparse.model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = test_features)
y_test <- test_df$win
```

## Baseline Model

```{r baseline}
params <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = c("logloss", "auc"),
  max_depth = 5,
  eta = 0.05,
  min_child_weight = 5,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8
)

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_train, label = y_train)
dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_test, label = y_test)

set.seed(42)
model <- xgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 500,
  watchlist = list(train = dtrain, test = dtest),
  early_stopping_rounds = 25,
  verbose = 0
)
```

```{r baseline_eval}
pred <- predict(model, dtest)
logloss <- -mean(y_test * log(pred + 1e-9) + (1 - y_test) * log(1 - pred + 1e-9))
auc <- xgb.eval.metric(preds = pred, labels = y_test, metric = "auc")
logloss
auc
```

## Grid Tuning (Coarse)

```{r tune_grid}
grid <- expand.grid(
  max_depth = c(3, 5, 7),
  eta = c(0.03, 0.05, 0.1),
  min_child_weight = c(1, 5, 10),
  subsample = c(0.7, 0.85),
  colsample_bytree = c(0.7, 0.85),
  gamma = c(0, 1)
)

cv_results <- list()
set.seed(42)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(grid))) {
  p <- as.list(grid[i, ])
  p$objective <- "binary:logistic"
  p$eval_metric <- "logloss"

  cv <- xgb.cv(
    params = p,
    data = dtrain,
    nrounds = 400,
    nfold = 5,
    early_stopping_rounds = 20,
    verbose = 0
  )

  best_iter <- cv$best_iteration
  best_logloss <- cv$evaluation_log$test_logloss_mean[best_iter]
  cv_results[[i]] <- c(grid[i, ], best_iter = best_iter, test_logloss = best_logloss)
}

cv_df <- bind_rows(lapply(cv_results, as_tibble))
cv_df <- cv_df %>% arrange(test_logloss)
head(cv_df, 10)
```

## Grid Tuning (Fine, Optional)

```{r tune_fine}
best <- cv_df[1, ]

fine_grid <- expand.grid(
  max_depth = c(best$max_depth - 1, best$max_depth, best$max_depth + 1),
  eta = c(best$eta * 0.5, best$eta, best$eta * 1.5),
  min_child_weight = c(best$min_child_weight, best$min_child_weight + 2),
  subsample = c(best$subsample - 0.05, best$subsample, best$subsample + 0.05),
  colsample_bytree = c(best$colsample_bytree - 0.05, best$colsample_bytree, best$colsample_bytree + 0.05),
  gamma = c(best$gamma, best$gamma + 0.5)
)

fine_grid <- fine_grid %>%
  mutate(
    subsample = pmin(pmax(subsample, 0.5), 1),
    colsample_bytree = pmin(pmax(colsample_bytree, 0.5), 1)
  )

cv_results_fine <- list()
set.seed(42)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(fine_grid))) {
  p <- as.list(fine_grid[i, ])
  p$objective <- "binary:logistic"
  p$eval_metric <- "logloss"

  cv <- xgb.cv(
    params = p,
    data = dtrain,
    nrounds = 500,
    nfold = 5,
    early_stopping_rounds = 25,
    verbose = 0
  )

  best_iter <- cv$best_iteration
  best_logloss <- cv$evaluation_log$test_logloss_mean[best_iter]
  cv_results_fine[[i]] <- c(fine_grid[i, ], best_iter = best_iter, test_logloss = best_logloss)
}

cv_df_fine <- bind_rows(lapply(cv_results_fine, as_tibble))
cv_df_fine <- cv_df_fine %>% arrange(test_logloss)
head(cv_df_fine, 10)
```

## Feature Importance

```{r importance}
imp <- xgb.importance(model = model)
head(imp, 20)
```
